source: EPA eGRID2023 rev2, ERCOT (BACODE ERCO) plants

other.basis: generation-weighted eGRID CO2 output rate of ERCOT plants with PLFUELCT in {BIOMASS, OFSL, OTHF} and positive 2023 generation; missing rates (batteries, waste heat) count as 0; biomass CO2 as reported by eGRID (0 for most). Dominated by Channel Energy Center (other gases). EIA-930 'other' is ~0.2 GW in ERCO, so this choice moves hourly CO2 by well under 1%.

nuclear.basis: no direct combustion emissions (storage: charging emissions are counted when the charging energy is generated)

hydro.basis: no direct combustion emissions (storage: charging emissions are counted when the charging energy is generated)

wind.basis: no direct combustion emissions (storage: charging emissions are counted when the charging energy is generated)

solar.basis: no direct combustion emissions (storage: charging emissions are counted when the charging energy is generated)

storage.basis: no direct combustion emissions (storage: charging emissions are counted when the charging energy is generated)

unknown.basis: never reported by ERCO in EIA-930; set to the gas factor if ever needed
